get.description: The process is up. Says nothing about the database or providers.
Ready for traffic: database reachable, migrations current, providers configured.
Send the browser to GitHub with a fresh state and PKCE verifier.
GitHub sends the browser back here; an allowlisted account gets a session.
Who is signed in, and the CSRF token to send with every change.

post.description:
Generate a loop now and return the finished run.

Retrying with the same operation_id returns the run already recorded (HTTP 200),
even while it is still generating; a different distance is refused.

200.description: The run already recorded for this operation

post.description:
Ask the route agent for a loop from the confirmed start. Every answer it gives
was approved by the judge or written by code from measured facts.

status.title: Status
status.description: Access anywhere else on the route is unknown, never verified

source.title: Source
source.description: The OpenStreetMap extract the check used

message.title: Message
message.description: An approved draft or the factual fallback; not stored

message_source.title: Message Source
message_source.description: An approved draft, or the factual answer code writes when none is approved

approvals.title: Approvals
approvals.description: The judge's decision on each draft; its reasons stay on the server

generation_run_id.title: Generation Run Id
generation_run_id.description: The stored run whose selected route the page draws and the GPX holds

AgentRun.title: AgentRun
AgentRun.description: How one route agent answer was made and judged. The brief and the answer are not kept.

brief.title: Brief
brief.description: What the user typed; not stored

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: asked_clarification or fallback: why, as a code

AgentStep.title: AgentStep
AgentStep.description: One step the run took, in order. Only what code recorded, never model text.

DistanceRange.title: DistanceRange
DistanceRange.description: Exact lower and upper bounds. No tolerance is added on either side.

DistanceTarget.title: DistanceTarget
DistanceTarget.description: One distance to aim for. A loop within 10% either side of it is acceptable.

revision.title: Revision
revision.description: The request revision, numbered from 1; never changed

outcome.title: Outcome
outcome.description: A start is never chosen automatically: even a single match needs confirming.

more_results.title: More Results
more_results.description: OneMap has more pages; a more specific query helps.

near_m.title: Near M
near_m.description: Route length within 8 m: crossings, bridges, paths beside

on_m.title: On M
on_m.description: Route length running along the road itself

RestrictedRoad.title: RestrictedRoad
RestrictedRoad.description: One OpenStreetMap road from the restriction check that the route comes near.

seed.title: Seed
seed.description: Round-trip seed; null for a via loop

requested_length_m.title: Requested Length M
requested_length_m.description: Length asked of HeiGIT, after correction

reasons.title: Reasons
reasons.description: Why this candidate was rejected; empty if accepted

operation_id.title: Operation Id
operation_id.description: Chosen by the client. Sending the same one again returns the same run.

duration_s.title: Duration S
duration_s.description: HeiGIT's time for the profile. For running it is a walking time.

unknown_surface_share.title: Unknown Surface Share
unknown_surface_share.description: Share of the distance with no known surface

csrf_token.title: Csrf Token
csrf_token.description: Send as X-CSRF-Token with every POST.
